caption: Early ResNet-50 blocks stay frozen; for 2,000 images only the new 10-class head is trained, and it has 20,490 parameters (20,480 weights + 10 biases). For 50,000 images the last block is also unfrozen at a small learning rate.

spec.title: Transfer learning
spec.aria: A vertical pipeline takes 2,000 images of size 224×224 through frozen early ResNet-50 blocks, a last block that is frozen for 2,000 images but unfrozen for 50,000, global pooling to 2,048 features, a new 10-class fully connected layer with 20,490 parameters, and softmax.
